messages:
Marta: Quick heads-up — ACME Cloud + Nimbula GPUs co-hosted hybrid webinar on 2027-05-12 11:00 PT. We need to lock speakers, demo host, and finalize swag shipping plan.
Sam: I can take the product intro (10m) and the Q&A moderation.
Jules: Happy to run the live perf demo if infra is stable. Need a checklist for the demo env and fallback plan.
Ravi: Who's owning the infra? I can stand up a dedicated test pool on 'redwood-demo-az1' but need a list of models + max seq length.
Marta: @Ravi please use: models: redwood-large-v1 (8k), redwood-medium-quant (4k). Keep a warm replica and fallback policy to hosted-small.
Kevin: For fallback, add automatic routing to hosted region us-west-2. I'll wire the smart routing policy.
Ana: Marketing needs speaker bios + headshots by next Tue (2027-04-28). Also confirm if we can include a coupon code for attendees.
Sam: Coupon ok. Proposed code: ACME_NIMBULA_REDX10 — 30 days credit.
Jules: Demo run-of-show draft: 1) intro (Sam) 2) product pitch (Marta) 3) live perf demo (Jules) 4) partner segment (ACME rep) 5) Q&A. Need 1 tech rehearsal and 1 full run-through.
Marta: Rehearsal slots: 2027-05-05 10:00 PT (tech), 2027-05-10 09:00 PT (full). Confirm availability.
Ravi: I'll be there for both. Will post the temporary access token in the infra channel before tech rehearsal.
Kevin: SWAG: what's the ask? T-shirts + stickers + one premium item? Budget wise marketing gave $1.2k.
Ana: Prefer premium item = portable charger/branded power bank. Estimates: 100 units ~$900 + shirts/stickers $250 + shipping $150. Fits $1.3k though. Need approval for +$100.
Marta: Approve +$100 from partnership comms. Go ahead. Ana, please confirm final PO.
Ana: Will do. Shipping plan: ship to Partner Fulfillment (address below) by 2027-05-03. Please format labels with partner PO and "Event: ACME Webinar".
Ana: ```
Partner Fulfillment
ACME Logistics Center
Unit: Redwood/ACME Webinar
123 Harbor Way
Oakport, CA 94000
```
Sam: Demo fallback note: capture a short pre-recorded screen capture of the demo steps in case live model stalls. Jules can record 3-min clip.
Jules: I'll record and upload to GDrive link after rehearsal.
Marta: Press/partners comms: decide on joint announcement timing. Proposed: send a co-announcement 2027-05-12 15:00 PT (after webinar). Any objections?
Kevin: Sounds good. Also add a short ops blurb about dedicated capacity for customers who want predictable latency.
Ravi: One more infra note — enable prefix caching on the demo instance to avoid cold-start token costs during the live run.
Ana: Logistics checklist to ship: PO, packing list, labels, customs forms (N/A domestic), inbound tracking. I'll circulate a doc.
MarketingBot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal (2027-05-05 10:00 PT) set by @Marta.
Marta: Thanks team. Action items: Sam (moderation & coupon), Jules (demo + recording), Ravi (demo infra + token), Kevin (routing + ops blurb), Ana (swag PO + shipping). Please update this thread when tasks are done. :thumbsup:
